
# Autogenerated Ingress Definitions and Storage Class References

 These two features moved to **production** status with the release of version 1.2.36 (15APR2025)
and are now documented in our Help Center documentation.

## Autogenerated Ingress Definitions
 * See the [Configure Access to Web Applications](https://documentation.sas.com/?cdcId=obsrvcdc&cdcVersion=v_003&docsetId=obsrvdply&docsetTarget=n0auhd4hutsf7xn169hfvriysz4e.htm#n0jiph3lcb5rmsn1g71be3cesmo8) topic for further information about the autogeneration of web access.

 ## Autogenerated Storage Class References
 * See the [Customize StorageClass](https://documentation.sas.com/?cdcId=obsrvcdc&cdcVersion=v_003&docsetId=obsrvdply&docsetTarget=n0auhd4hutsf7xn169hfvriysz4e.htm#p1lvxtk81r8jgun1d789fqaz3lq1) topic for further information about the autogeneration of storage customizations.
